displayDescription: Screen-print run on blue-gray stock: teal and orange inks overprint, then a paper-tone bulb grows into a connected network.
styleRenderer: SVG (spot-color layers, clipPath squeegee pulls, static feTurbulence ink-edge filter, luminance grain masks, mix-blend-mode multiply overprint)
motionEngine: Motion 14.1.0 pure utilities (interpolate, easeInOut, easeOut, backOut, clamp) bundled locally as motion-print.js
GSAP paused timeline used only as the seekable composition clock
limitations: Ink, overprint and paper are procedural approximations. Multiply blending stands in for transparent ink overprint, and the bulb and network use an opaque paper-tone ink instead of true unprinted knockouts.
Grain masks and paper fibre are seeded textures pre-rendered with sharp (tools/make-textures.mjs). They are not scans of real prints.
The orange large display word (SPARK) has a contrast of about 3.3:1 on the paper, which meets the large-text target only. All small copy is teal on paper (about 6.9:1).

The background review covered only one matched source, from stills sampled at 1–8 s. Only its craft lessons were applied: grainy spot inks, overprint, hatch pattern, knockout label box and word-by-word build. Its colors, subject and lettering were not used.
